turns_text: [SEG0001] person_1 (CLINICAL_STAFF): Mrs Deshmukh, kindly come this side. I have checked your vitals — blood pressure is one eighteen over seventy-six, pulse eighty-two, temperature thirty-seven point two.
[SEG0002] person_2 (PATIENT): Thank you so much. The waiting area is quite pleasant today, the fan is working.
[SEG0003] person_3 (DOCTOR): Hello, Mrs Deshmukh, do sit down. I am Dr Mehta. What has been troubling you?
[SEG0004] person_2 (PATIENT): Good afternoon, doctor. I am having burning when I pass urine. It has been there since three days, and it is quite uncomfortable.
[SEG0005] person_3 (DOCTOR): I am sorry, that is miserable. How has it been affecting your day?
[SEG0006] person_2 (PATIENT): Every time I pass urine it burns, doctor, and I have to go much more often. At night I am getting up twice.
[SEG0007] person_3 (DOCTOR): Have you noticed any fever with this episode?
[SEG0008] person_2 (PATIENT): Doctor, this is the third time this year I am getting this same problem. It is becoming a habit, I feel.
[SEG0009] person_3 (DOCTOR): Alright, we will come to how often. I do want to know about fever, though — any fever at all this time?
[SEG0010] person_2 (PATIENT): No, doctor. No fever. I even checked with the thermometer at home.
[SEG0011] person_3 (DOCTOR): Any blood in the urine, or pain in the back?
[SEG0012] person_2 (PATIENT): No blood, doctor, and the back is not paining. It is only the burning and running to the toilet.
[SEG0013] person_3 (DOCTOR): You mentioned this is the third time this year. Were those episodes much the same?
[SEG0014] person_2 (PATIENT): Yes, similar only. Um, well, actually, maybe it is the fourth. I forgot one in the summer. I am sorry, my count is not exact.
[SEG0015] person_3 (DOCTOR): Please, no apology needed. Did you take anything for it before coming?
[SEG0016] person_2 (PATIENT): I am embarrassed to admit this, doctor. I took my elder sister's leftover antibiotic — those white and yellow capsules, the urine ones. I cannot recall the name.
[SEG0017] person_3 (DOCTOR): I appreciate you telling me plainly. How did you take them, and are you still on them?
[SEG0018] person_2 (PATIENT): One capsule in the morning and one at night, by mouth, for two days. Then the strip got over, so I stopped. I did not purchase them myself.
[SEG0019] person_3 (DOCTOR): Any other tablet, for the discomfort?
[SEG0020] person_2 (PATIENT): I took Crocin yesterday, two tablets, when the burning was too much. I have not taken it today, so I have stopped for now.
[SEG0021] person_3 (DOCTOR): Okay. Sometimes this comes with vaginal discharge or itching. Has there been any of that?
[SEG0022] person_2 (PATIENT): No, doctor. Nothing of that kind. I am perfectly fine in that respect.
[SEG0023] person_3 (DOCTOR): And through the day, are you managing to drink enough water?
[SEG0024] person_2 (PATIENT): At the office I forget, doctor. Maybe four glasses only, which I know is less. The meetings run long.
[SEG0025] person_3 (DOCTOR): Office days do that. Let me just return to what I asked — you said no discharge and no itching. Is that fully true, or was there something you hesitated to mention?
[SEG0026] person_2 (PATIENT): I am sorry, doctor. I was shy. There is a little itching since yesterday, but there is no discharge. I should have said so at once.
[SEG0027] person_3 (DOCTOR): Thank you, that is useful, and there is no need to feel shy here. Any heaviness or pain low in the tummy?
[SEG0028] person_2 (PATIENT): A little heaviness, doctor, just above the front. Not severe. My husband said I should not delay the visit, so I came today itself.
[SEG0029] person_3 (DOCTOR): Good that you came. Let me press gently on the tummy. The lower abdomen is soft, it is a bit tender just over the bladder, and there is no guarding.
[SEG0030] person_3 (DOCTOR): From what you have told me and from this tenderness, this is most likely another urine infection, though I cannot confirm it until we test.
[SEG0031] person_3 (DOCTOR): I am ordering a urine routine and a urine culture. Please give the sample today, before any new antibiotic.
[SEG0032] person_2 (PATIENT): Yes, doctor, I will. May I take the Crocin again if the burning is bad?

[SEG0033] person_3 (DOCTOR): Yes. You may take Crocin, five hundred milligrams, one tablet by mouth, up to three times a day if the burning is bad. Do not exceed that. And try to sip more water, little and often.
[SEG0034] person_2 (PATIENT): Thank you, doctor. I will follow that. Kindly say when I should come back.
[SEG0035] person_3 (DOCTOR): Come back in three days. If you develop fever or the burning becomes severe before that, come sooner, do not wait.

[SEG0036] person_1 (CLINICAL_STAFF): Mrs Deshmukh, I will collect the urine sample in the side room — both the routine and the culture, as written. If it is not coming, drink a little water and we will wait.
[SEG0037] person_2 (PATIENT): Yes, I can try just now. Thank you for your kindness, doctor. I will be careful with the tablets.
